page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with marginal notes in the left margin. Page number and running head at the top. Catchword at the lower right.
page.running_head: De Agro Fris. inter Lavic. & Amas.

main_text.l: Quinetiam scloppetariorum praefecti qua-
tuor diu in civitate fuere, à senatu quoque
designati, perpetui. Hi curam armorum
habebant, juventutemque maximè ex-
ercebant in tractandis scloppetis, foro
venalis annonæ, quæ ad urbem defertur
quotidie, præstant: à pistoribus & iis,
qui cerevisiam coquunt, ne quid fraudis
committeretur, ut justa esset ponderum
& mensurarum ratio in officinis, cœ-
num ut publicis locis amoveretur, pro-
curabant. Quæ omnia nunc ad centurio-
nes oppidanos octo, qui iis successêre,
translata sunt. Denique ÆDILES duo
in Reip. sunt Trib. potestatis, quam non
lege datam, sed paulatim nitendo longiùs
tubulentis[?] actionibus quæsitam proximis
sæculis usurparunt non magno sanè Re-
ip. bono. Horum magnum esse nomen
solet. Et quoniam cum plebe opificum
& institorum connexi sunt, ac ab eâ de-
pendent, de plebis hujus ordine & di-
stinctione paucâ hic dicam. Dividitur
ipsa secundùm artificiorum aut rerum,
quas tractant, genera diversa in societa-
tes XVIII: exceptis, qui cerevisiæ co-

marginalia.note: De Ædili-bus Trib. Potest. & societati-bus plebeis

page.notes: Printed text is in a single column. The left margin holds two notes: the first beside the opening paragraph ("Sclopetario-rum capi-tanei, nunc cohortium praefecti"), the second beside the sentence on the Aediles ("De Ædili-bus Trib. Potest. & societati-bus plebeis"). Doubtful readings: "tubulentis" (possibly printed as it stands) and the spelling "scloppetariorum"/"scloppetis" (the first letter looks like long s). "praestant" is printed "praetant" and is kept as printed; the rendering "præstant" in the text above may need checking against the scan. Running head and page number are read from the top of the page. The paragraph ends at "co-" because the catchword "quendæ" stands below the last full line.
